Nike

Going Global with Nike Olympics

GlobalCampaign
200M+Views
IntegratedCampaign
The Brief

Lead Nike's in-store, social and OOH creative for the Olympics. Get the world talking about Nike and their athletes, while they weren't a sponsor of the Games.

The Idea

We shot the leading Olympic athletes in lead up events doing their 'victory dance or move'. This was turned into content that was ultra shareable when the athletes won. Then we blended athlete and UGC content into experiences that put everyday fans alongside their heroes — across billboards, social and retail.
